claimBoundary: Artifact audit, deterministic compiler replay, automated package grading, real browser generation, archive verification, responsive browser inspection, and anonymous Codex artifact review only. This does not prove universal factual correctness, instructor approval, classroom outcomes, statistical confidence, or paid-model parity.

attachedPhysicalGeologyFailure.rootCause: The package registry promised A14.2 Final (50%), but the Lesson 14 Quiz & Exam Bank content did not contain the registered final assessment. The ZIP layer was healthy; contradictory assessment typing had crossed the compiler boundary.

premiumTrustState.intervention: A zero-finding A/B package is clean even when score or texture is below 100; scores remain visible, while actual findings, low grades, source caveats, export warnings, and failures retain their review or blocked state.

localPersistenceRecovery.failure: The full saved graph can still exceed localStorage quota after deliverables are omitted.
localPersistenceRecovery.repair: Persist a compact, re-compilable course-map recovery snapshot rather than failing the local save or requiring a model rerun.

assignmentExportIdentityRecovery.failure: A brief linked to Lesson 1 but due in Week 4 was scoped as Lesson 4, leaving the current Assignment Briefs tab falsely empty and replacing Ready with Finish package.
assignmentExportIdentityRecovery.repair: Related lesson identity now outranks scheduling metadata; due dates no longer decide which lesson owns an assignment.

measuredChanges: Locatable-passage assignments and assessments for named readings
Reading-specific concepts, interpretive tensions, and evidence boundaries
Criterion-varied rubric self-assessment, analysis, revision, and submission language
Final paper weight 16% and proposal weight 5%

scionStrengths: Consistent evidence, counter-reading, and revision structure
Assessment weights total 100% with a meaningful final-paper share
remainingGaps: Oversimplified factual statements about The Library of Babel
Generic or meta-procedural quiz language and distractors
Insufficient course-specific depth across learner-facing surfaces
anonymousPaidReferenceReview.decision: No paid-reference parity claim. Prioritize a safer concept ledger and assessment-depth compiler work.
